title: Stock market today: Dow sinks 600 points, S&P 500, Nasdaq drop to cap a volatile week, oil prices rise
summary: U.S. stocks fell Friday: the Dow dropped 600+ points (-1.2%), the S&P 500 lost 0.5%, and the Nasdaq slipped 0.2%. WTI crude closed above $103/barrel. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq both recorded losses for a second straight week, weighed by AI spending concerns, elevated oil prices, and uncertainty ahead of the Oct 27-28 FOMC meeting.
why: 美股连续两周下跌，道指周五单日跌600点，近期AI资本支出担忧与油价高企叠加形成压力。下周FOMC（10月27-28日）会议及大科技公司财报（Alphabet、SK海力士等）是关键催化剂，Sell Put策略建议等待方向确认再布局。

title: Brent crude oil tops $116, a six-month high, as tensions swell in the Middle East
summary: Brent crude futures settled at $116.72 a barrel on Friday, the highest settlement since late April, gaining 3.1% on the day. WTI crude also rose, closing above $103/barrel. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and escalating US-Iran tensions continued to drive prices higher for a third straight week.
why: 布伦特原油周五结算于116.72美元，创约6个月新高，连续三周上涨。高油价推升通胀预期，压制美联储降息空间，同时利好港股油气股（中石油、中石化等）。对持有消费/科技类股票而言，能源成本上升可能影响企业利润率，需关注。

title: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings: What analysts are saying after revenue holds at $28B, operating income falls 56%
summary: Tesla Q3 2026 revenue was $28.05B, roughly flat YoY. GAAP operating income fell 56% to $718M (2.6% operating margin) as R&D and AI spending climbed 39%. Non-GAAP EPS of $0.48 beat consensus of ~$0.45. Automotive gross margin improved to 18.5%. Cybercab (Robotaxi) service started. Analysts debate whether the cost shift is temporary or structural.
why: 延续报道：特斯拉Q3财报于10月21日盘后发布，10月22日分析师评述持续。利润骤降56%（操作利润仅2.6%）但毛利率回升至18.5%，Robotaxi落地是中长期看多催化剂。短期股价可能因利润低迷承压，对TSLA Sell Put持仓需重新评估支撑位。

title: With earnings in rearview mirror, SpaceX-Tesla merger chatter takes center stage
summary: After Tesla and SpaceX both reported Q3 earnings, market focus shifts to the potential merger between the two companies. Both boards have formed special committees of independent directors. Analysts note the combined entity could exceed $3.5 trillion, with negotiations requiring shareholder votes and regulatory reviews in multiple jurisdictions.
why: 延续报道：特斯拉/SpaceX合并委员会成立（10月21日），10月23日焦点转向合并估值与流程。若合并成真，特斯拉股东将获得并入SpaceX航天/星链资产的溢价，属于估值重估类事件，对TSLA中长期持仓构成潜在正催化剂，但监管审查周期长不确定性大。

title: 晚报丨全球科技股跌势暂歇，亚洲市场跌后修复；小摩称本轮抛售可能已近尾声
summary: 摩根大通策略师认为全球科技股本轮抛售可能已接近尾声，亚洲市场跌后修复。彭博数据显示韩国股市市盈率跌破5倍，CoreWeave融资缺口引发市场争议，MiniMax开源新一代Flash大模型。花旗拿下国内证券牌照。
why: 小摩称「抛售近尾声」判断对短期布局有参考价值——若成立，本周港股/A股大跌或已接近底部，Sell Put策略可关注在当前超卖位置卖出行权价较低的put；但需结合下周FOMC（10月27-28日）和Alphabet/SK海力士财报确认后再行动。

title: American Express Q3 2026: Record revenue $20.1B (+9%), GAAP EPS $5.42 (+31%), full-year guidance raised
summary: American Express reported Q3 2026 record quarterly revenue of $20.1 billion, up 9% YoY. GAAP EPS was $5.42, up 31%; adjusted EPS was $4.68, up 13%. Pretax income rose 18% to $4.5 billion. The company raised its full-year 2026 EPS guidance. (Source: SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1, October 23, 2026.)
why: 美国运通Q3业绩亮眼，营收和利润均超市场预期，全年指引上调，反映高端消费信用需求仍健康。虽非直接持仓，但AXP作为高端消费/支付领域标杆，对海底捞、携程、迪士尼等消费标的宏观判断有正面参考意义。

title: Hong Kong shares edge higher by midday, Xiaomi advances 5 percent
summary: Hong Kong shares recovered by midday on October 23 after the previous session's sharp selloff, with Xiaomi (1810.HK) advancing about 5% as auto stocks led the rebound. The broader market rally provided some relief after the Hang Seng Index fell 3% the day prior.
why: 小米10月23日反弹约5%，在汽车股领涨的修复行情中表现较强。汽车业务（YU7、SU7系列）持续交付，加之新车型商标近期获批，仍是中长期支撑。近期股价从高位大幅回调，若反弹持续可考虑covered call策略。
